rationale: The agent did look up the user by name/ZIP and fetched order details/products, but then executed an exchange write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the changes with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. There is no evidence the agent verified the replacement keyboard met the requested specs (clicky, RGB, full-size or fallback to no backlight) or that the thermostat was confirmed to be Google Home compatible before proceeding. The conversation also lacks a summary of the changes, costs/refund details or payment method confirmation, and next steps. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
